high.finding: Round-3 HIGH is not fully closed. ae_v4.E still says an incorrect diagnosis causes contradictory findings to be pointed out, while ae_v4.D, play_seeds_v5, c_compression_v4, and adopted t1c require completely flat feedback that identifies neither diagnosis nor evidence errors. This is current mechanic-defining content, not merely historical text.

The softened candidate cards make pneumonia the best overall diagnosis, and the exam wording is now distinct from asthma wheeze, but they do not justify accepting exactly {talk,exam,lab,xray} and rejecting every other evidence subset. A careful player can defensibly choose {talk,lab,xray}: symptoms plus a focal radiographic change and inflammatory markers support pneumonia without requiring crackles. Conversely, including SpO2 as relevant supporting evidence is clinically defensible even though it does not distinguish etiology. The cited heart-failure source also states that crackles commonly occur in heart failure, so exam is not independently pneumonia-specific. Exact-set scoring therefore punishes valid clinical reasoning.

The heart-failure card attributes the statement that inflammatory markers usually do not rise from heart failure alone to the cited Japan Heart Foundation page, but that page discusses BNP/NT-proBNP and does not substantiate the WBC/CRP claim. The pneumonia guideline landing page likewise establishes the guideline's existence but does not itself substantiate all simplified candidate-card wording.

medium.finding: The design now specifies one independent shuffle per session, stable retries, restart-only reshuffling, and ID-based scoring. That is sufficient design-stage direction, but implementation must be regression-tested because an index-based or remount shuffle would reopen the §3 answer leak.

Four candidate cards, six evidence cards, reference-card expansion, state, attempts, feedback, and submit control have no demonstrated 375px layout. This can remain an implementation-stage gate if GAME_SPEC defines progressive disclosure, minimum readable text/tap targets, and how selection state remains visible; a bare 'all content without scrolling' assertion is not adequate verification.

low.finding: design-sim.mjs still contains stale header comments saying three diagnoses, 189 combinations, and that talk carries 38.6°C, despite the executable model correctly using four diagnoses, 252 combinations, and nonnumeric talk. This is documentation polish but contradicts the claimed comment repair.

ae_v4.C and several narrative fields still refer to fact_sheet_v3 even though fact_sheet_v4 is the current source of truth. The adopted translation mostly references v4 correctly, so this is traceability polish rather than a mechanic defect.

failure_codes.finding: ae_v4.E retains specific-contradiction feedback while the adopted mechanic requires fully flat feedback.
Exact-match evidence scoring rejects other clinically defensible evidence subsets and treats exam as mandatory despite crackles also being common in heart failure.
The cited heart-failure source does not support the candidate card's WBC/CRP claim.
Implementation must prove stable per-session shuffling and ID-based scoring.
The complete ten-card interaction has not been demonstrated at 375px.

verdict.alternative_evidence_subset_reasoning: {talk,lab,xray} is defensible because the several-day fever/cough course, elevated inflammatory markers, and focal right-lung radiographic change already form a coherent pneumonia case; auscultatory crackles add support but are neither necessary nor exclusive, and the cited heart-failure source says crackles are also common in heart failure. A player may also reasonably include SpO2 as important evidence of pulmonary illness severity, even though it does not discriminate among the four etiologies. Therefore only one diagnosis is best supported, but only one exact evidence subset is not clinically justified.

sim_verification.notes: The direct command executed all calculations but could not overwrite design-sim-result.json because the review environment is read-only. The same current script was rerun with only its final writeFileSync line omitted. All ten verdict flags were true: legitimate=1.0, no-number strategies=0, select-all=0, fixed-position single=0.016 versus 1/60, fixed-position cycled=0.0326 versus 1/30, random joint guessing=0.0077, and one winning combination out of 252. Position leakage and number-format shortcuts did not regress.

recommended_actions: Redesign evidence evaluation so it rewards a clinically sufficient rationale instead of one hidden exact subset—for example, require diagnosis plus evidence covering explicit dimensions such as course, focal localization, and inflammation, with multiple valid card combinations or an explicit distinction between diagnostic and severity evidence.
Have a clinically qualified reviewer approve the allowed evidence combinations and candidate-card claims; add a source that directly supports the WBC/CRP comparison or remove that statement.
Replace ae_v4.E's specific-contradiction behavior with the exact adopted flat-feedback and partial-outcome behavior, and update stale v3 references.
Correct design-sim.mjs header comments to four diagnoses, 252 combinations, and qualitative talk evidence.

In GAME_SPEC, make stable per-session shuffling, ID-only scoring, restart boundaries, and a concrete 375px progressive-disclosure layout acceptance criteria; retain both as mandatory implementation QA gates.
